title: Fix repo-wide duplicate .meta GUID shared by ArcadeControls.inputactions and InputSystem_Actions.inputactions
description: rev-t026 hygiene find (TASK-026 review, pre-existing — introduced at d597f0b, TASK-006 era): GUID 8404be70184654265930450def6a9037 is shared by Barcade/Assets/Barcade/Input/ArcadeControls.inputactions.meta and Barcade/Assets/InputSystem_Actions.inputactions.meta. Duplicate GUIDs make Unity's asset resolution nondeterministic — any scene/prefab/component referencing that GUID may bind to either asset depending on import order. Determine which asset live references actually point at (grep scenes/prefabs/asset files for the GUID), keep the GUID on that asset, remint a fresh unique GUID for the other, fix any references that break, and verify via the Unity gate (clean import, compile, input still works in a PlayMode smoke or the Hito 1 scene UAT). Requires the Unity Editor/batchmode — coordinate with the next Unity-gated work (TASK-027/028 window).
acceptance_criteria: A repo-wide scripted duplicate-GUID check (grep across all .meta files) reports zero duplicates
The GUID stays with whichever asset existing scenes/prefabs reference; the other asset gets a freshly minted unique GUID; no reference breaks (verified by grep + Unity import)
Unity gate passes: clean import/compile with no missing-reference warnings for the two .inputactions assets, and 4-player input still functions (PlayMode smoke or scene UAT)
